name: Affordable Housing Production by Building
description:
This dataset records affordable housing production at the building level, with one row per building associated with a housing project. Each record includes project and building identifiers, project and building start/completion dates, and the address (house number, street, borough, postcode) along with geographic identifiers such as BBL, BIN, community board, council district, census tract, neighborhood tabulation area, and latitude/longitude coordinates. The data covers all five New York City boroughs, with Brooklyn and the Bronx making up the largest shares.

The dataset also describes each building's construction type (new construction or preservation), extended affordability status, prevailing wage status, and unit counts broken down by income band (extremely low, very low, low, moderate, middle, and other income) and by bedroom size (studio through 6-bedroom, plus unknown). Summary counts include counted rental units, counted homeownership units, all counted units, and total units.
